svg.aria-label: Top: 20 held-out handwriting images. Bottom: all 60 outputs for fixed eight-dimensional noise inputs after 1,200 tiny-DCGAN updates, using one 0–1 grayscale. Data: E. Alpaydin and C. Kaynak, UCI, CC BY 4.0. Generated images come from the trained model.
